messages:
marta: Heads-up — noticed a spike of near-duplicates in the labeler queue after the q8b bring-up. Seeder shows a lot of overlap from poolbank shards 42/43.

dylan: hmm, is this from the tokenizer change in q8b or sampling logic?

marta: looks like tokenizer + our recent prefix normalization. Short prompts that used to hash differently are now colliding. Example: 'How do I reset my passcode?' vs 'How can I reset my passcode' mapped to same fingerprint after token truncation.

kevin: do we have a quick query to surface duplicates? I can run a scan.

marta: yep — pulled a tiny SQL: ```SELECT sample_id, fingerprint, COUNT(*) FROM labeler_queue WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY sample_id, fingerprint HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;```

anya: re: operational impact — labeler throughput down ~8% because they keep getting duplicates. Also some golden candidates slipped into active sets.

marta: exact — spotted 12 golden-like items routed to normal queue. Not a ton but enough to bias metrics for the new model smoke.

kevin: ok i'll run the de-dup pass and tag provenance. Plan: (1) run dedupe on queue, (2) tag any item where fingerprint != orig_fingerprint_before_q8b as "post-q8b-tokenization" in metadata, (3) re-run a small golden-recon. Sound good?

dylan: +1. Can we also snapshot tokenized text and store token_ids for auditing? Would help track quantization/tokenizer drift.

marta: yes please store token_ids with a minimal retention (30d) — add TTL. 

labeler-bot: ACTION_CREATED: ticket #MI-4518 created for dedupe-run and provenance tagging. Assignees: @kevin @anya. ETA 48h. :white_check_mark:

anya: quick note — when deduping, prefer keeping the item with higher context_len and richer metadata (lang, source). That's what labelers prefer.

kevin: noted. I'll implement comparator: prefer max(context_len) then non-null source, then earliest ingest_ts.

marta: also, small change to sampler: raise per-shard threshold from 0.05 to 0.075 for poolbank shards 42/43 to reduce overlap until we get tokenizer fix in place. Dylan can you sanity-check the math?

dylan: checked — should reduce expected overlap by ~55% for short prompts. But will slightly reduce rare-intent coverage. I recommend adding a compensating scheduled sampler that ramps rare-intents for next 24h.

anya: agree. I'll schedule a short rare-intent sweep tomorrow morning (02:00 UTC) to top-up holdouts.

kevin: running dedupe now on a dry-run. ETA ~30m, pushing tags to staging first. Will paste logs.

marta: thanks. After dedupe, can we re-eval the canary promptset against q8b and q4b to ensure we didn't silently improve/degrade? Need the comparison metrics (exact-match, BLEU-ish, and hallucination rate).

dylan: will spin up a quick bench. Suggest comparing: baseline (q4b-v2), q8b-unaligned, q8b-with-prefix-fix. Put results in /eng-ml/bench/reports/1719500000-dup-provenance.

labeler-bot: STATUS_UPDATE: dedupe dry-run complete in staging. 1,120 duplicates flagged, 92 golden-candidates moved to golden-review.

kevin: pushing live now. Tagging done. I also took a token_ids snapshot for 100% of flagged items. Link: https://internal.artifacts/snapshots/1719500000-tokenids

marta: perfect. @anya once the rare-intent sweep done, can you confirm holdout counts and we'll schedule a mini-golden re-run?

anya: will confirm. if holdouts < target we'll top-up by sampling bias multiplier 1.6.

dylan: one last thing — let's add a telemetry flag to the sampling service to emit fingerprint version used (v1/v2) so we can quickly diagnose future shifts. Small patch, low-risk.

marta: agreed. I'll create the PR. Thanks team, keeping this thread for postmortem notes and the bench link. :thumbsup:
